trust_decision.summary: An enrollment token's lifetime must follow operator configuration (per-network network_config['enrollment_token_ttl'], else the server.yml enrollment_token_ttl default, else 24h), and the decision is taken where the token row is minted: internal/api/hosts.go:195, internal/api/hosts.go:566 and internal/api/updates.go:266 resolve it, while internal/web/handlers.go:915 minted the Web UI token with a hardcoded 24h.

landing_point.why: The summary names Web UI host creation minting a 24-hour bearer enrollment token; this is the only hardcoded expiry literal left on a production token-mint path, and the handler is the target of POST /ui/hosts (internal/web/web.go:302).

fix_sites.entry_point: Web.WithEnrollmentTokenTTL / Web.tokenTTLFor (web package wiring; new field + setter, anchored at internal/web/web.go:78-81)
enrollment.TokenTTL (new exported library primitive in a new internal/enrollment package)

fix_sites.module_kind: API service resolver (refactor onto the shared policy, behaviour-preserving)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about a Web UI handler, the UI already has its own 24h built-in default, and feeding the YAML server default into the UI binary lives in internal/cli — server plumbing, not the reported bug — so a web-only fix can be called complete; that argument leaves the operator-configured server-level TTL ignored by the UI.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A host of kind mobile returns before the token sink and must keep creating no enrollment token (it receives a self-contained YAML bundle); an over-broad 'every host-create path must mint a policy-bounded token' refactor would leave a dangling pending token for mobile hosts. Adjacent precedence must also survive: a per-network override must win over the server default even when it is longer, not be clamped to it.

O6_input_shapes: per-network enrollment_token_ttl present and valid (e.g. 30m) — wins over the server default
per-network value empty or row missing — falls through to the server-level default
per-network value unparseable (e.g. "not-a-duration") — falls through, no error
networkID empty (admin creates a host without a network) — lookup skipped, server default used
server-level default unset, zero or non-positive — built-in 24h fallback

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Web UI 'Regenerate enrollment token' / 'Re-enroll' POST route on the host detail page, minting a single-use token like the API handler at internal/api/hosts.go:527.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The UI already ships per-host action buttons (mobile-bundle/generate, block) right there, and the API has had /enrollment-token and /reenroll since ADR 0004, so UI parity is an obvious next commit — a copy of the 24h literal would land with it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A mobile/QR install variant that mints an enrollment token from the branch that currently returns early before the token sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment there already explains why mobile hosts skip the enrollment flow; adding a QR/agent-on-mobile flow means minting inside that branch, which bypasses whatever resolver the agent branch gains.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A bulk/fleet host-provisioning route (POST /api/v1/hosts/bulk or a manifest importer) that mints one token per host, each possibly in a different network.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ADR 0004 §6.1 discusses pre-auth key fleets and autoscaling; a fleet import would loop host creation and need a per-host-network TTL lookup — the same check at a second site with a different code path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Store-level default: CreateHostAndToken / CreateTokenForHost filling ExpiresAt from the per-network config when the caller passes a zero expiry.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Defence-in-depth at the one choke point every mint goes through is a natural maintainer move, and it is exactly the tempting over-broad fix: the store can read network_config but cannot see the server-level default, so it silently caps the API path at the built-in 24h.

O9_family: CWE-613 insufficient session expiration — enrollment-token lifetime not bound to the configured token-lifetime policy

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Look up network_config['enrollment_token_ttl'] directly inside handleHostCreate with a 24h fallback, never threading the server-level config default into the Web UI and never touching the store's token-mint API.

out_of_scope_notes: internal/models/operator.go:52-60 — operator API keys have no expiry field at all (only CreatedAt/LastUsedAt/RevokedAt); noticed while mapping token-mint sinks, outside this advisory's enrollment-token protection, not pursued.

Hidden-test surface: the published regression test drives the server-default case through Web.WithEnrollmentTokenTTL (fix.diff:307), a method name and signature a solver cannot derive from the report; if hidden tests keep that call the task is unfair, and if they only exercise the per-network override the composition-root/config-loader scope trap is unobservable.

Per-network enrollment_token_ttl has no production writer at the pinned commit: the only non-test network_config write is the firewall route (internal/api/firewall.go:126), so any behavioural test must seed the value through store.SetNetworkConfig (internal/store/sqlite.go:2183) as the published test does.
